x_posts.text: Both DC Open finals were washed out Sunday, played Monday. Fritz def. Jódar 7-6(2), 6-4. Eala def. Pegula 4-6, 6-4, 6-0. A Monday of results that will shape the entire North American hard court swing. #TennisNews #ATP #WTA
